description: Fires mainly when column 5 holds exactly one stone (cell above it empty) and the opponent has stones around it on the bottom two rows of columns 3-5: typically opponent stones at the bottom of columns 3 and 5 and/or on row 2 of columns 3-4, with my stone at the bottom of column 4 or 6. My stone on row 2 of column 3, or any stone at row 2 of column 5, largely switches it off.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves any column's probability by at most about 0.10 (usually under 0.03) across 5 positions.
notes: Histograms: (1,5) empty and (0,5) filled in ~96% of top-band firing. act minimal pairs: base 4,5,6,4,0,3 = 7.0; filling (1,5) by either side -> 1.4; my stone at (1,3) -> 1.7; shifting or mirroring the pattern kills it (position-specific, not translation invariant). Same board reached by different move orders gives different activations (0.39 vs 0.97), so a board rule has a ceiling. Dev F1 by version: 0.24, 0.29, 0.29, 0.26, 0.31 (final), 0.31; best sim share 0.20 (p3, F1 0.29); final p5 sim share 0.11. Many late-game firings and some with column 5 empty or full are missed; may be a distributed/random direction.
